audit_metadata_addendum.condition: Publish these three original path/hash/review records only in addition to the exact 448 manifest paths. The manifest is nonrecursive and does not hash itself or these final review files. Bind their bytes in the subsequent transport/sync receipt; no scientific or manuscript file substitution is authorized.

limitations: This is public content/integrity release QA. It relies on the named hash-bound independent manuscript and PDF reviews; it does not repeat visual rendering, clinical evaluation, generation or mathematical tests.
The immutable-regression check covers all 380 prior inventory sources, current review bindings and declared reused figures; it is not a global filesystem-write audit of unexported material.

Original controllers/tests preserve documented work-versus-reports, absolute bundle, source-access and runtime requirements. Passing this release gate is not a claim of turnkey full scientific reproduction.

Publication remains a separate parent action with an expected-head lease at the reviewed base and post-publication byte/diff verification. Any change to the staged 448-byte set or manifest invalidates this PASS and requires review.
